title: Live: Pope Leo visits migrant aid centre on second day in Paris
summary: Pope Leo XIV on Saturday kicked off his second and last day in Paris with a visit to the migrant support centre Maison Bakhita. In his address to the young migrants, he said the centre is a testimony to the fact that it is possible to “live together in dignity and peace”. Follow our liveblog for all the latest on the pope's four-day visit to France.
